intents.text: Add Response.apply_conditions(request, *, exists=True) in wrappers/response.py evaluating If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since per RFC 9110 order/comparisons for all methods, star ETag per `exists`, raising PreconditionFailed on failure, converting to 304 (entity headers removed) for satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD, and setting Accept-Ranges: bytes.

Add Response.apply_range(request) that always sets Accept-Ranges: bytes, applies Range only for GET with 200 and known non-zero Content-Length (bytes unit only, clamp stop/suffix, first range only, RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable if unsatisfiable, else 206 with sliced data and Content-Range), and honors If-Range via ETag strong comparison or Last-Modified.

Keep Response.make_conditional working but emit DeprecationWarning, implemented via apply_conditions and apply_range; deprecate werkzeug.http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid the same way.

Make Range.from_header, Range.make_content_range and ContentRange.from_header validate their own values; make_content_range clamps too-large stop/suffix and uses the first range; ETagSet.from_header discards invalid unquoted values.
Add IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) -> bool in datastructures/range.py, true for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified, used by apply_range.

Refactor send_file in utils.py to use the new methods, detect name/size/mtime from file-like objects when possible, seek(0) file-like objects, drop the path hash from the ETag, and default to application/octet-stream when download_name is absent instead of raising.
Refactor SharedDataMiddleware to serve via send_file, stop setting cache_timeout by default, and deprecate (still accept, with DeprecationWarning) the cache and fallback_mimetype parameters.
Document apply_conditions and apply_range in the quickstart docs and add a changelog entry.

Add tests for apply_conditions (each header, methods, star ETag with/without resource, 304 vs 412) and apply_range (first range, clamping, unsatisfiable, 206 Content-Range); update send_file tests for detection, seek, ETag and mimetype; move/remove tests of the deprecated functions; suite `pytest -m "not dev_server"` stays green.

constraints: Deprecated APIs must keep working while emitting DeprecationWarning
Test suite must pass with pytest -m "not dev_server"
